__comment: Per-asset prompts for tools/generate_assets_rd.py. Every entry is keyed by FULL repo-relative path — several stems (cadantine, torstol, spider_den, ...) exist as both an item icon and an entity image, and a bare filename key would apply one prompt to both. Value is a prompt string, or an object with any of: prompt, seed, style, size, remove_bg. An override replaces the whole prompt — the kind's suffix is NOT appended. Retro Diffusion's guidance: describe the subject only, never write 'pixel art'. Pin a seed on an asset you like to keep it stable across --force runs.
